## Required documents

### Documents to be submitted by applicant (representative)

1. One copy each of the person's family relations certificate and basic certificate. If the person has died or been declared missing and those certificates do not establish the relevant facts, one certified copy of the removed family register or closed family relations certificate.

2. One designation of representative heir, only where two or more heirs have equal priority.

3. One power of attorney to receive retirement compensation, only for an application by an agent because of emigration, hospitalization or another unavoidable reason.

4. One copy of other documents proving eligibility for retirement compensation.

5. One copy of the page showing the applicant's name and account number in the bankbook for the account at the post office or financial institution where payment is desired.

### Items to be verified by the responsible official

If the applicant does not consent to verification by the responsible official, the applicant must submit the document directly.

One certified copy of the applicant's resident registration record.

Fee: None

I consent to the responsible official verifying the above items through joint use of administrative information under Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act in processing this application.

Applicant (representative): [ ] (Signature or seal)

210 × 297 mm (ordinary paper, 60 g/m², recycled).

Reverse

## Instructions for completion

1. Complete every field in Hangul or Arabic numerals and mark the applicable choice with “√”. In fields ① and ⑧, write the name first in Hangul, then in Chinese characters in parentheses.

2. In fields ② and ⑨, enter the registered residential address and telephone number.

3. In field ③, enter the type, institution and grade (rank) at the end of actual service as a disqualified or automatically retired public official.

4. If the official has died, enter the death date in field ④ and attach the basic certificate from the family relations register, a certified copy of the removed register, a medical death certificate or another document proving death.

5. If the official emigrated abroad, enter the issue date of the passport for residence abroad in field ⑤ and attach a passport copy or another document proving that date.

6. In field ⑥, enter the first appointment date and grade (rank), and subsequent changes in status due to transfers, promotions and similar actions, separately for each employing institution.

7. In field ⑦, describe the grounds for disqualification under public-service personnel legislation, including the State Public Officials Act and Local Public Officials Act. If based on punishment or discipline, describe the crime or disciplinary grounds.

8. Normally, the applicant is the disqualified or automatically retired official. If deceased or declared missing, heirs apply in succession order; two or more equal-ranking heirs must select a representative. If the person or heir cannot apply directly because of emigration, hospitalization or another unavoidable reason, attach a power of attorney to receive compensation certified by the head of an institution specified in the subparagraphs of Article 4(3) of the Enforcement Decree of the above Act.

9. In field ⑪, enter the post office or bank or other financial institution where the applicant wishes to receive compensation and the account number; attach a copy of the bankbook page showing the name and account number.
